audit.why: Lane difficulty (TRICKY, 7/10) is well-supported: Nami wins the poke/sustain war early but Pyke's kit (hook, camo engage, execute R) flips it hard from level 6 on.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-3].side read 'Pyke' and phases[4-6].side read 'Skill', but content win[0-6] and the packet levelChart both say Nami wins 0-3 and Pyke wins 4-6, and the .why text for phases[0-3] already describes Nami's advantage.
audit.why: The full-layer side/rating array disagreed with its own why text and with the content layer's win[] array and the packet's levelChart, which is the exact chart-integrity bug the run is checking for.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0-3].side to Nami (matches win[0-3], no win edit needed) and phases[4-6].side to Pyke (matches win[4-6], no win edit needed); rewrote phases[4-6].why to state Pyke's level-6/item-spike advantage explicitly instead of vague/neutral text.

audit.why: Bone Skewer (Q) is an interruptible channel, Ghostwater Dive (W) grants camo needing wards/sweeper, Phantom Undertow (E) is a stun-dash denyable by grounding, and Death From Below (R) is an execute — all already reflected correctly in ability text, but Pyke's passive resistance-bypass (Gift of the Drowned Ones) was unmentioned in prose.
audit.corrected: Added a Don'ts note that his passive heals him in fog and raw armour/MR stacking does not answer it.

edits.before: Tidal Wave online — engages arrive on a wave and disengages leave on one.
edits.after: Death From Below (R) executes and resets — this level-6 spike belongs to him.

edits.before: First item: the bounce chunks and the bubble converts every gank.
edits.after: First item: his roams and hook pressure convert kills you can't match.

edits.before: Late Nami conducts: wave the engage, bubble the peel, and E whoever's swinging.
edits.after: Late Pyke hunts: his reset-chaining R on your backline outweighs your peel plan.

edits.before: W the bounce through carry-and-support, E your carry, auto — the trade healed you, billed them, and buffed the follow-up.
edits.after: Bubble the engage the instant Bone Skewer (Q) is thrown — its 8-10s cooldown is your green light to punish the whiff.

edits.before: Throwing the bubble at poke range out of boredom — the stun is the matchup; the rest is salad.
edits.after: Diving after a reset — his Gift heals him in fog; armour/MR alone won't stop that regen.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Pyke Bone Skewer (Q): 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s cooldown — his R cleans what it catches, so read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Aqua Prison: 12-8s answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
